title: Colorimetric visualization detection of perfluorooctanoic acid based on host–guest interactions with cyclodextrin-modified gold nanoparticles
content:
Environ. Sci.: Nano, 2025, 12,1581-1591
DOI: 10.1039/D4EN01096E, Paper
Jiateng Ma, Chuang Liu, Jiali Li, Zhiquan An, Bihong Zhang, Wenjun Hong, Cheng Ye, Minjie Li, Liang-Hong Guo
Our colorimetric sensor developed with cyclodextrin-modified gold nanoparticles provides a nano-sensor for the visual detection of PFOA with simplicity, rapid detection, and cost-efficiency.
